confidence_notes: Food anchors use current Miami cost-of-living survey prices and the cocktail estimate uses a local bar-price average. The wine-glass price is estimated from the local draft-beer price; accommodation estimates are less certain and vary by season and neighborhood.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food and drink are based on Miami's own reported prices, while lodging is estimated from general knowledge of a high-demand U.S. coastal destination.
